novel_features.name: Cross-marketplace compare
novel_features.description: See one product's current, lowest and average prices on the US, AU and other Amazon sites side by side.
novel_features.rationale: camelcamelcamel and every existing tool show one marketplace per lookup; this aligns several in one table.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when the question is where a product is cheapest relative to its own history.

novel_features.name: Personal price trend
novel_features.description: See how a product's price moved across your own past lookups (history, deal, compare, watch add and watch check save snapshots), including new all-time lows.
novel_features.rationale: camelcamelcamel exposes only lifetime summaries and a chart image; the local snapshot store builds a real timeline over time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this to answer 'has the price changed since I last checked?' without a network call.

novel_features.name: Watchlist near-lows ranking
novel_features.description: Rank every watched product by how close its current price is to its lowest-ever price (needs watch add and watch check first).
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining the local watchlist with the latest stored snapshot of every product.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this to answer 'which of my watched items should I buy now?'

novel_features.name: Unseen drops
novel_features.description: Show only the top price drops you have not already seen in earlier pulls.
novel_features.rationale: The drops feed has no read state; a local table of past pulls makes the daily scan incremental.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this for a daily deal scan that skips items already reviewed.

narrative.headline: Paste an Amazon URL (US, AU, UK, CA, DE, FR, IT or ES) and get its price history: exact lowest, highest, current and average for every price type, plus an approximate dated series read from the chart.
narrative.value_prop: It reads camelcamelcamel's public price pages for eight Amazon marketplaces. history gives the exact lifetime summary and a dated price series reconstructed from the chart image (approximate, about a day per pixel). deal gives a buy/wait verdict, compare puts marketplaces side by side, and every lookup saves a snapshot that trend and lows analyze offline.
narrative.auth_narrative: No account or API key is needed. camel-cli sends an honest camel-cli User-Agent and about one request per second (history fetches the page plus one chart image; compare fetches one page per marketplace). Site search is not available because Cloudflare challenges every non-browser client on that page.

quickstart.comment: Check the install without any network call
The headline: price history for an Amazon URL
Buy-or-wait verdict from current vs lowest and average

troubleshoots.fix: camelcamelcamel has no history for that ASIN on that marketplace; try another --locale or add it on the website
Wait a few minutes and retry; do not change the User-Agent to a browser string, because that triggers the challenge
Pass --locale au (or us, uk, ca, de, fr, it, es) when giving a bare ASIN

narrative.when_to_use: Use camelcamelcamel-pp-cli when an agent or user asks whether an Amazon price is good, what the lowest or highest price was, or how a product's price compares across Amazon marketplaces. It also covers daily deal scans (drops, popular, fresh-drops) and a local watchlist.
anti_triggers: Searching Amazon by keyword (site search is blocked; get the product URL or ASIN first)
Buying, carting or checking out on Amazon
Exact day-by-day prices: the dated series is approximate (read from the chart image, about one day per pixel); only the lowest, highest, current and average values are exact
Marketplaces other than us, au, uk, ca, de, fr, it, es (for example amazon.co.jp)

recipes.title: Price history for a pasted URL
recipes.explanation: Detects the AU marketplace from the domain and prints the three price types.

recipes.title: Just the verdicts for an agent
recipes.explanation: Skips the chart and narrows the JSON to the title and one verdict per price type.

recipes.title: Daily unseen drops in electronics
recipes.explanation: Shows only electronics drops of 30% or more that earlier pulls did not record at that price.

recipes.title: Which watched items are near their low
recipes.explanation: Ranks watched products from their stored snapshots; run watch add and watch check first.
